mapper.select: SELECT FROM iam_employee WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND employee_no=#{code}
SELECT FROM iam_employee WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM iam_org c JOIN iam_org d ON d.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.id=#{companyId} AND c.org_type='COMPANY' AND c.enabled AND d.id=#{orgId} AND d.org_type='DEPT' AND d.enabled AND d.org_path LIKE c.org_path || '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_employee SET user_id=#{userId},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{e.tenantId} AND id=#{e.id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND version=#{e.version} AND user_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM iam_user u WHERE u.tenant_id=#{e.tenantId} AND u.id=#{userId} AND u.company_id=#{e.companyId} AND u.org_id=#{e.orgId} AND u.enabled)
UPDATE iam_employee SET status='LEFT',left_at=clock_timestamp(),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{e.tenantId} AND id=#{e.id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND version=#{e.version}
UPDATE iam_user SET enabled=FALSE WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId}
